## Configuration and Setup

```{r configuration}
config <- list(
  filtering = list(
    abs_filt_samples = 2,
    min_count_threshold = 10
  ),
  statistical = list(
    padj_cutoff = 0.05,
    log2FC_cutoff = 1,
    var_expl_needed = 0.6
  ),
  visualization = list(
    ntop_genes_pca = 1000,
    plot_width = 20,
    plot_height = 20,
    plot_units = "cm",
    top_pathways_show = 20
  ),
  fgsea = list(
    min_size = 15,
    max_size = 500
  )
)

PATHS <- list(
  data_dir = here::here("data", "RNAseq"),
  results_dir = here::here("results", "RNA-seq", "RNA-seq_shRNA"),
  resources_dir = here::here("resources")
)

print("Configuration loaded successfully")
```

```{r}
# make PCA with ALL samples
# Filtering lowly expressed genes
shRNAdds_filt <- filterDatasets(shRNAdds,
                               abs_filt = TRUE,
                               abs_filt_samples = config$filtering$abs_filt_samples
)

# Estimate size factors and running DESEQ2
shRNAdds_filt <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(shRNAdds_filt)
shRNAdds_filt <- DESeq2::DESeq(shRNAdds_filt)
dds_reduced_filt_vsd <- DESeq2::vst(shRNAdds_filt, blind = TRUE) # blind = TRUE for QC

resultsNames(shRNAdds_filt)
```

```{r Get DEGs, include=FALSE}
deg_results <- generateResults(
  dds_object = shRNAdds_filt,
```

```{r}
RNA_SEQ_data <- openxlsx2::read_xlsx("~/neuroblastoma/results/RNA-seq/RNA-seq_MES_vs_ADR/tables/MES_vs_ADR_comprehensive_results.xlsx", sheet = 2)
mes_adrn_gene_list <- RNA_SEQ_data %>%
  mutate(Term = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0, "ADR", "MES"))
sig_list_our_data <- list(
  Aderenergic = mes_adrn_gene_list$gene_symbol[mes_adrn_gene_list$Term == "ADR"],
  Mesenchymal = mes_adrn_gene_list$gene_symbol[mes_adrn_gene_list$Term == "MES"]
)

# prepare vsd
vsd_counts_matrix <- assay(dds_reduced_filt_vsd)
gene_symbols <- annotation_data[, 'gene_symbol'][match(row.names(vsd_counts_matrix),
                                                       annotation_data[, 'ensembl_id'])]
# Drop genes without a mapped symbol
keep <- !is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""
vsd_counts_matrix <- vsd_counts_matrix[keep, ]
gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[keep]

# Collapse duplicate symbols: keep the row with the highest mean expression
row_means <- rowMeans(vsd_counts_matrix)
keep_idx <- order(row_means, decreasing = TRUE)
keep_idx <- keep_idx[!duplicated(gene_symbols[keep_idx])]
vsd_counts_matrix <- vsd_counts_matrix[keep_idx, ]
row.names(vsd_counts_matrix) <- gene_symbols[keep_idx]

vsd_counts_matrix <- as.matrix(vsd_counts_matrix)
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(vsd_counts_matrix))))


# Plot terms based on terms defined from RNA-seq profiles obtained from our RNA seq
our_data_param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(vsd_counts_matrix,
                                    sig_list_our_data,
                                    minSize = 1, maxSize = Inf,
                                    normalize = TRUE)
ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines <- GSVA::gsva(our_data_param,
                                      verbose = TRUE,
                                      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(2))

# Replicate groups to average (CM_48h has only 2 replicates)
replicate_groups <- list(
  CM_24h     = c("CM_24h_batch1",     "CM_24h_rep1_1",       "CM_24h_rep2_1"),
  CM_48h     = c("CM_48h_batch1",     "CM_48h_rep1_1"),
  CM_control = c("CM_control_batch1", "CM_DMSO_ctrl_rep1_1", "CM_DMSO_ctrl_rep2_1"),
  SH_24h     = c("SH_24h_batch1",     "SH_24h_rep1_1",       "SH_24h_rep2_1"),
  SH_48h     = c("SH_48h_batch1",     "SH_48h_rep1_1",       "SH_48h_rep2_1"),
  SH_control = c("SH_control_batch1", "SH_DMSO_ctrl_rep1_1", "SH_DMSO_ctrl_rep2_1")
)

# Collapse a ssGSEA score matrix to per-group means (rows = terms, cols = groups)
average_replicates <- function(mat, groups) {
  avg <- vapply(groups, function(cols) {
    cols <- intersect(cols, colnames(mat))
    rowMeans(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  }, FUN.VALUE = numeric(nrow(mat)))
  rownames(avg) <- rownames(mat)
  as.matrix(avg)
}


ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines,
                                                        scale = "row",
                                                        #annotation_col = heatmap_col_annot_DTC,
                                                        cluster_rows = TRUE,
                                                        cluster_cols = TRUE,
                                                        color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
                                                        show_colnames = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "ssgsea_mes_adr_heatmap_all.pdf"),
       plot = ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap,
        width = 22, height = 12, units = "cm")

# Averaged across replicates
ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines_avg <- average_replicates(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines, replicate_groups)
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap_avg <- pheatmap::pheatmap(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines_avg,
                                                            scale = "row",
                                                            #annotation_col = heatmap_col_annot_DTC,
                                                            cluster_rows = TRUE,
                                                            cluster_cols = TRUE,
                                                            color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
                                                            show_colnames = TRUE,
                                                            main = "SSGSEA our RNA-seq terms (averaged replicates)")

ggsave(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "ssgsea_mes_adr_heatmap_all_averaged.pdf"),
       plot = ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap_avg,
        width = 22, height = 12, units = "cm")
```

```{r ssgsea_heatmap_by_batch}
# The two batches differ strongly in overall ssGSEA level, so a single row-scaled
# heatmap is dominated by the batch effect rather than the MES/ADR contrast.
# Split the samples by batch and z-score WITHIN each batch so the biology is visible.

# Batch membership: the collapsed "biosample" names carry the _batch1 tag;
# everything else (rep1/rep2 runs) is the second batch.
sample_batch <- ifelse(grepl("_batch1$", colnames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines)),
                       "batch1", "batch2")

# Column annotation (cell type / treatment / time) pulled from the dds colData,
# aligned to the ssGSEA matrix column order.
col_annot <- as.data.frame(
  colData(shRNAdds_filt)[colnames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines),
                         c("cell_type", "treatment", "time")]
)

# Build one heatmap per batch (silent = TRUE so we control drawing/saving).
batch_heatmaps <- lapply(sort(unique(sample_batch)), function(b) {
  mat_b <- ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines[, sample_batch == b, drop = FALSE]
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat_b,
    scale = "row",              # z-score within this batch only
    annotation_col = col_annot,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    main = paste0("MES/ADR ssGSEA — ", b),
    silent = TRUE
  )
})
names(batch_heatmaps) <- sort(unique(sample_batch))

# Draw each heatmap into the knitted document.
for (b in names(batch_heatmaps)) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(batch_heatmaps[[b]]$gtable)
}

# Save each heatmap to its own PDF.
for (b in names(batch_heatmaps)) {
  pdf(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, paste0("ssgsea_mes_adr_heatmap_", b, ".pdf")),
      width = 8, height = 5)
  grid::grid.draw(batch_heatmaps[[b]]$gtable)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r ssgsea_dynamics_prep}
# Instead of absolute ssGSEA levels (which carry a per-batch / per-cell-line
# baseline), look at the DYNAMIC: the change over the DMSO -> 24h -> 48h course.
# Referencing each series to its own DMSO baseline cancels that baseline offset,
# so CM and SH (and the two batches) become directly comparable.

adr_name <- grep("^Ader", rownames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines), value = TRUE)  # "Aderenergic"
mes_name <- grep("^Mes",  rownames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines), value = TRUE)  # "Mesenchymal"

# One row per sample, with its two signature scores and its metadata.
score_long <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
score_long$ADR <- ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines[adr_name, score_long$sample]
score_long$MES <- ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines[mes_name, score_long$sample]

# Cell line (CM / SH) and series group (batch1 / rep1 / rep2) from the sample name.
score_long$cell  <- sub("^(CM|SH)_.*", "\\1", score_long$sample)
score_long$group <- ifelse(grepl("_batch1$", score_long$sample),
                           "batch1",
                           stringr::str_extract(score_long$sample, "rep[12]"))
# A "series" is one time course: e.g. CM_batch1, CM_rep1, SH_rep2, ...
score_long$series <- paste(score_long$cell, score_long$group, sep = "_")

# Time as an ordered factor DMSO < 24h < 48h (from the dds colData).
score_long$time <- factor(
  as.character(colData(shRNAdds_filt)[score_long$sample, "time"]),
  levels = c("DMSO", "h24", "h48"),
  labels = c("DMSO", "24h", "48h")
)

# Long over signature, then Delta = score - (that series' DMSO score).
score_long <- score_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(ADR, MES),
                      names_to = "signature", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(series, signature) %>%
  mutate(baseline = score[time == "DMSO"][1],
         delta    = score - baseline) %>%
  ungroup()

print(score_long)
```

```{r ssgsea_dynamics_trajectory}
# (1) Trajectory line plots: Delta-from-DMSO vs time, one line per series,
#     faceted into MES and ADR panels.
p_traj <- ggplot(score_long,
                 aes(x = time, y = delta,
                     group = series, colour = cell, linetype = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ signature) +
  labs(title    = "MES / ADR ssGSEA dynamics (Δ from DMSO)",
       subtitle = "Each series referenced to its own DMSO baseline",
       x = "Time", y = "Δ ssGSEA score (vs DMSO)",
       colour = "Cell line", linetype = "Series") +
  theme_bw()

print(p_traj)
ggsave(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "ssgsea_mes_adr_trajectory_delta.pdf"),
       p_traj, width = 22, height = 12, units = "cm")
```

```{r ssgsea_dynamics_delta_heatmap}
# (2) Delta-from-DMSO heatmap: rows = signature, columns = series x timepoint
#     (24h, 48h only; DMSO is the reference so its delta is 0).
delta_hm_df <- score_long %>%
  filter(time != "DMSO", !is.na(delta)) %>%
  mutate(col_id = paste(series, time, sep = "_"))

delta_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(delta_hm_df[, c("signature", "col_id", "delta")],
                                 names_from = col_id, values_from = delta)
delta_mat <- as.matrix(delta_wide[, -1])
rownames(delta_mat) <- delta_wide$signature

# Column annotation + a stable ordering (by cell, then series group, then time).
col_annot_delta <- delta_hm_df %>% distinct(col_id, cell, group, time)
col_annot_delta <- data.frame(
  cell  = col_annot_delta$cell,
  group = col_annot_delta$group,
  time  = col_annot_delta$time,
  row.names = col_annot_delta$col_id
)
ord <- rownames(col_annot_delta)[order(col_annot_delta$cell,
                                       col_annot_delta$group,
                                       col_annot_delta$time)]
delta_mat <- delta_mat[, ord, drop = FALSE]

# Diverging colour scale centred on 0 (no row scaling: values are already deltas).
max_abs <- max(abs(delta_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
delta_breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 51)

delta_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  delta_mat,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
  breaks = delta_breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  annotation_col = col_annot_delta,
  main = "Δ ssGSEA from DMSO (24h, 48h)",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  silent = TRUE
)
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(delta_heatmap$gtable)

pdf(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "ssgsea_mes_adr_delta_heatmap.pdf"),
    width = 8, height = 4)
grid::grid.draw(delta_heatmap$gtable)
dev.off()
```
